verdict.rationale: Svelte's docs say you can try Svelte online in the playground (svelte-docs-45), and a community user calls the interactive tutorial with sandboxes "really impressive" and "a great onramp" (svelte-comm-17). That covers hands-on, in-browser learning with no local setup, and the CLI can turn a playground URL into a full project (svelte-docs-15). missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the interactive tutorial itself (lessons, structure), recent independent corroboration (the community report dates from the Svelte 3 era).
